name: SK Hynix Inc.
blurb: SK Hynix is South Korea's second-largest semiconductor company and the world's leading manufacturer of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) — the stacked DRAM architecture used in AI accelerators including NVIDIA's H100 and B200. The company holds an estimated 50%+ share of HBM supply to NVIDIA and is the primary beneficiary of the AI infrastructure memory supercycle. SK Hynix also produces NAND flash and enterprise SSDs through its Solidigm subsidiary.
recent: SK Hynix reported record Q1 2026 revenue of KRW 52.6 trillion, up 60% QoQ and 198% YoY, driven by surging HBM3E shipments. Morgan Stanley raised its 2026 and 2027 EPS forecasts by 56% and 63% respectively. HBM capacity for 2026 is reportedly fully committed. The stock trades at a forward P/E of ~4.3x — an extreme discount to the sector median that reflects persistent cyclical skepticism despite structurally different AI-driven demand.
